draft.subject: Re: API pagination — and your first project
draft.body:
Hi Theo,

Glad the first week has gone well so far, and thanks for your patience on the API pagination question — Tariq still has that ticket open and will follow up with the details. In the meantime, one thing worth knowing: list endpoints use cursor-based pagination, so you shouldn't need to pull everything in one call.

On the product side, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them. Would a short call this week help — I can walk you through setting up your first project and inviting the team?

Best,
Chidi
